caveats: These are reported household practices, not tonnes collected, collection frequency, recycling rates or wastewater-treatment quality. Sector percentages have different household denominators and cannot be added or averaged without weights. The national total overlaps the four sectors. Published percentages are rounded; 0.0 can conceal a small nonzero share. Missing methods within a waste type are not assigned zero. The source wording Composing solid waste is retained. This import uses the downloaded final-report edition; older cached copies at the same URL can contain different biodegradable-waste percentages.
Percentages retain one decimal place; 0.0 is a rounded published value, not proof that no households use a method. Methods absent from a waste category are not fabricated as zeros.
grain: One census household measure, waste type, main disposal method and sector in 2024
notes: The 2024 census reports household shares by main disposal method for biodegradable waste, polythene and plastic, electronic waste, glass and bottles, other solid waste, and liquid waste. Figures cover Sri Lanka and four separately reported sectors: urban, estate-urban, rural and estate-rural. The solid-waste table also reports each sector’s household count.
